relationships.subject: piceatannol
relationships.evidence_quote: PCN administration can counteract the decline in mitochondrial function and antioxidant activity in diabetic rats and HG-exposed N2A cells by increasing the SIRT1 and Nrf2 activities

relationships.subject: SIRT1
relationships.evidence_quote: SIRT1 activation also enhanced Nrf2-mediated antioxidant signalling

relationships.subject: SIRT1
relationships.evidence_quote: Peroxisome proliferator activated receptor-gamma coactivator-1α (PGC-1α) directed mitochondrial biogenesis was induced by increased SIRT1 activation by piceatannol

key_findings: Piceatannol activates SIRT1 and Nrf2, restoring mitochondrial function in diabetic rats and high-glucose N2A cells.
